auth.tagline: Upload your sales data, see how healthy it is, and get answers backed by evidence.

auth.registerSubtitle: One account per company. You can invite your team later.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Avoid common passwords and don't include your name or email.
auth.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
auth.badCredentials: That email and password don't match. Check them and try again.

upload.title: Upload your sales data

analyse.body: Apply safe fixes as a new version, then run the analysis and see each step.

errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.forbidden: Your role can't do this. Ask a company owner or admin.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find that. It may have been deleted.

errors.rateLimitedSeconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
errors.email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.

errors.corrupt_file: We couldn't open this Excel file. Open it in Excel, save it again, and upload it.
errors.unknown_sheet: That sheet isn't in the workbook. Choose one of its sheets.
errors.dataset_not_ready: This dataset is still being prepared. Wait until it's ready.

errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.intro: Each upload becomes a dataset. Cleaning it creates a new version and keeps the original.
datasets.emptyBody: Upload a CSV or Excel file of your sales or orders. We'll check its health and suggest fixes before any analysis.

upload.title: Upload data
upload.intro: Upload one file per dataset. Your original file is always kept.
upload.dropTitle: Drag a file here, or choose one
upload.dropHint: CSV, TSV or Excel (.xlsx), up to {limit} MB. The first row should hold the column names.
upload.name: Dataset name
upload.nameHint: Shown in your dataset list. You can use the file name.
upload.wrong_type: "{file}" isn't a CSV, TSV or .xlsx file. Excel's older .xls format isn't supported; save it as .xlsx first.
upload.empty: "{file}" is empty. Choose a file that has a header row and data.
upload.too_large: "{file}" is {size}, over the {limit} MB limit. Split it or remove unused columns.

detail.processingBody: We're converting the file and detecting column types. Large files take a minute.
detail.checkingBody: Measuring missing values, duplicates and formats in every column.
detail.failedHelp: Check that the file opens in a spreadsheet app and has one header row, then upload it again.

health.relative: Compare scores between versions; the number isn't an absolute grade.
health.noIssues: No problems found. This data is ready for analysis.

plan.intro: Fixes create a new version; your current version stays unchanged. Low-risk fixes are selected for you. Review medium and high-risk fixes before selecting them.
plan.none: Nothing to fix. This version needs no cleaning.

riskHelp.low: Changes formatting only; values keep their meaning.
riskHelp.medium: Changes or removes some values. Check before applying.
riskHelp.high: Can change the meaning of your data. Apply only if you're sure.

plan.affected: {rows, plural, =0 {No rows} one {# row} other {# rows}} affected

strategies.impute_mode: Fill with the most common value

plan.dateOrderHelp: Both readings are possible in this column. Choose the one your system uses.
plan.selectedCount: {count, plural, =0 {No fixes selected} one {# fix selected} other {# fixes selected}}
plan.applied: Fixes applied. Version {version} is being prepared.

columns.intro: Roles tell the analysis what each column means. Change any that look wrong.
columns.personalHelp: Treated as personal data: the assistant cannot read these values unless your company allows it.
columns.rolesChangedBody: Your current results still use the old roles. Run the analysis again to update them.

preview.caption: First {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} of {total}

analysis.intro: The analysis runs each module on this version and explains any it skips.
analysis.notRun: No analysis has run on this version yet.
analysis.insights: {count, plural, =0 {no findings} one {# finding} other {# findings}}

dashboard.body: Your key figures, trends and forecast will appear here once a dataset has been analysed.
